source_findings.worker_wiring: src/main.rs:253-265 spawns rootyard::webhooks::background::worker only when ROOTYARD_OUTBOX_WORKER is true.
source_findings.durable_scan: src/webhooks/background.rs:15-46 scans every 2s, also wakes on local notification, and loops sync_outbox_events until zero so a 200-row LIMIT cannot permanently skip later events.
source_findings.pull_repair: src/webhooks/background.rs:50-72 repair_pull_orchestration selects open PRs missing ci_pull_sync_progress for current version/head/base/storage; on_pull_synchronized is idempotent and writes the progress marker last. The scan also calls sync_pull_events and reconcile_pull_refs.
source_findings.outbox_fanout: src/webhooks/delivery.rs:111-168 selects outbox events only when an active subscribed hook lacks a per-hook delivery, inserts ON CONFLICT(webhook_id,event_id) DO NOTHING, and orders by operation/transaction sequence.
source_findings.claim_fence: src/webhooks/claims.rs:19-51 atomically UPDATEs pending/due-failed/due-leased rows to leased, increments attempts and lease_generation, and sets next_attempt_unix = now + ceil(timeout_ms/1000) + 5. src/webhooks/claims.rs:53-73 completion requires state=leased AND lease_generation=claim generation; mismatch returns current row instead of overwriting.
source_findings.retry_lease: src/webhooks/handlers.rs:416-438 manual retry is conditional on state <> leased OR lease due, else HTTP 409; reset starts a new generation. deliver_now is optional.
source_findings.backoff_dead_letter: src/webhooks/delivery.rs:46-54 and 424-456 use base 2s exponential backoff capped at 300s; attempt >= max_attempts becomes dead_letter; failed/dead_letter rows remain listable through /deliveries.
source_findings.pr_pin_and_checks: src/webhooks/delivery.rs:337-493 creates deterministic pull CI job UUID, immutable refs/rootyard-ci/jobs/{job_id}, ci_runs queued row, forge_check_runs queued row, signed pull_request delivery, then ci_pull_sync_progress. Existing old-head queued/leased runs are cancelled by the head/base/storage predicate.
source_findings.tls_ssrf: src/webhooks/signing.rs:177-242 validates URL, resolves all addresses and rejects any non-permitted peer, pins the selected address with reqwest .resolve, sets redirect Policy::none and no_proxy, uses default roots plus optional ROOTYARD_WEBHOOK_CA_FILE, and sends only HTTPS except loopback HTTP. src/webhooks/models.rs:322-412 blocks private/loopback/non-global targets and permits loopback only for explicit loopback hostnames.
source_findings.trust_runs: src/webhooks/trust.rs binds contexts to an active webhook and requires a current successful ci_run attempt/lease_generation; src/webhooks/runs.rs report requires leased state, exact attempt/lease_generation, live head/base/version, and an unexpired lease, with completed idempotent replay only for identical digest.

issue3.evidence: ci_webhook_regressions creates 201 valid outbox events for one push hook and two manual dispatch calls: first enqueued 200, second enqueued 1, all 201 delivered. Source query selects missing deliveries per hook and background worker loops until zero.

issue16.evidence: Concurrent two-dispatch regression sends exactly one receiver request and leaves delivered. Source claim/complete uses state=leased plus lease_generation fence, so a stale completion cannot overwrite a newer state. Worker ack test proves real lease expiry and same delivery id retry; retry-overlap test proves manual retry returns 409 while the worker owns a live lease.
issue16.residual: The exact runtime ordering delivered-then-stale-HTTP-500 is not directly reproduced (P2-2); generation fence is source-verified.

issue19.evidence: Real TLS loopback receiver with leaf issued by test CA and SAN IP 127.0.0.1 is delivered once; the same plaintext receiver addressed as https is not contacted and ends dead_letter; unrelated-CA TLS receiver is rejected with zero HTTP requests. Source uses default roots plus optional private CA, hostname verification through reqwest, explicit redirect Policy::none, no proxy, all-resolved-address SSRF checks, and no HTTPS downgrade.
issue19.residual: No external/public-CA endpoint, redirect-to-private, or DNS-rebinding runtime case; loopback functional proof plus source inspection only (P2-5).

verdicts.supported_mode: Native compiled Rust service, disposable PostgreSQL 17, owned loopback HTTP/TLS receivers, real Git push and real process-group SIGKILL. No external endpoint, cloud, hardware, credentials, or production data.

p2.summary: No SIGKILL after the open-PR version/head/base UPDATE commits but before the new pin, queued ci_run/check, pull delivery, and ci_pull_sync_progress marker complete. repair_pull_orchestration exists and the marker is last, and sync_pull_events rescans all open PRs, so the durable guarantee is source-inspected rather than directly demonstrated by a crash in that exact phase.
p2.impact: Does not invalidate the three acceptance tests; limits runtime proof of post-commit orchestration repair.

p2.summary: No direct two-attempt race where attempt 1 commits delivered and a stale attempt 2 HTTP 500 completion is attempted. The concurrent regression proves only one sender claims; the ack test proves same-id retry after crash. claims::complete generation predicate is the source guarantee that stale results return current instead of overwriting.
p2.impact: Generation fence is clear in source; the exact stale-success-vs-failure ordering remains test-residual.

p2.summary: The 201-event regression uses one push hook and manual dispatch. It does not runtime-test multiple hooks, per-hook isolation, or a newly created subscription receiving eligible historical outbox events (the implementation defines this behavior via missing-per-hook-delivery selection; no explicit regression asserts it).
p2.impact: Original permanent-skip bug is fixed and tested; multi-hook/new-subscription semantics are defined by source but not independently pinned by a test.

p2.summary: The backoff case records scheduled_backoff_seconds=2 and receiver attempts [1,2], but the wall-clock lower bound assertion is only >=1.0s rather than >= the scheduled 2s. Observed real dead-letter delays were about 1.90s after the first failed completion.
p2.impact: Evidence is consistent with real-time 2s backoff, but the assertion could pass a shorter delay.

p2.summary: Redirect/DNS-rebinding and private-address resolution are covered by source policy (Policy::none, all-address permitted_peer, pinned resolution) and unit URL tests, not by a native redirect or rebinding receiver in this run. TLS proof is loopback with a local CA, not a public external endpoint.
p2.impact: No production defect identified; scope explicitly allows owned loopback functional proof.
